title: Report smoking or e-cigarette use in a smoke-free place
summary: You can report smoking or e-cigarette use in a smoke-free public place online.
intro:
Smoking and using e-cigarettes is banned by law in all enclosed public areas and certain outdoor public areas. If you think a smoking ban has been broken, you can report it online.

### Indoor smoke-free zones

Smoking and using e-cigarettes is banned in all enclosed public areas including in shopping centres, cinemas, libraries and public transport.

faqs.q: Where are smoking and e-cigarette use banned?
faqs.a: Smoking and using e-cigarettes is banned by law in all enclosed public areas and certain outdoor public areas.

faqs.q: What information do I need to report an incident?
faqs.a: You need to provide the place name and address, the date and time of the incident, a description of what happened, and optionally, your contact details or a photo.

faqs.q: How do I report a smoking or e-cigarette incident?
faqs.a: You can report it online by following the prompts to complete and submit the form at https://reportsmokingvaping.health.nsw.gov.au/Smoking-in-public-places/.
